title: [finding] post-stamped refuses every later body edit of a director-ruled card: lanes/director.md puts a bare UTC on the body first line (`Ruled: id · letter X · UTC`), the position the stamp contract reserves for the writing act
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). Two rules conflict. SKILL.md says to act on the stricter one and file a card, so this is that card.

## The two texts

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md`, line 12: 「录裁同笔改正文:首行加 `Ruled: <评论 id> · letter <X> · <UTC>`」. The director writes the ruling time as a bare stamp on the body's first line.
- `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (the positional refusal, over H56's reader): a bare stamp on an artefact's opening line belongs to the writing act. A later `--body=N` edit by any other seat is therefore refused. A declared-reading token at that position is refused too (`positional-declared`). The tool's remedy is to move the stamp into the body.

## Reproduced

- objectstack-ai/cloud#2435 had the first line `Ruled: 6063207364 · letter D (item 14) · 2026-10-08T15:27Z`.
- A one-line `Blocked-by:` re-point by `post-stamped.mjs --body=2435` was refused: `[positional] the opening line carries the bare stamp 2026-10-08T15:27Z`.
- The seat applied the tool's remedy: the first line lost its stamp, and the stamp sits two lines down as a declared reading, with the value unchanged. The audit note is objectstack-ai/cloud#2435 comment 6073436878.
- ⚠️ The refusal landed after the seat's audit comment had already gone up, so for a few minutes that card's comment described a body it did not yet have.

## Why it matters

Every card the director rules carries this first line. Any seat that later edits the card's body, for a `Blocked-by:` re-point, a `Maintainer-action:` line or a state line, hits the same refusal. The seat must then either rewrite the director's line or leave the state line stale.

## Asked of the skills lane

Decide which text moves. Either the director's `Ruled:` line drops its UTC, or carries it somewhere other than the first line (the ruling comment's own timestamp already carries the time). Or `post-stamped` exempts an opening line that is byte-identical to the stored body's opening line. ⛔ The seat changed neither text.

Dedupe: semantic searches of this repo for 「post-stamped refuses body edit because director Ruled first line carries bare UTC stamp positional」 and 「director Ruled line UTC first line card body later seat edit refused stamp contract」. Six `post-stamped` cards came up (#17314, #17763, #18284, #18293, #18995, #19319), all closed, all about other refusal shapes. None names the director's `Ruled:` line.
